name: deeppairing
description: Catch the wrong approach before Claude Code writes it — not in a 500-line diff after. Structured artifacts (findings, options, decisions, plans) you approve before code lands, a rejection gate that stops a concept you've turned down before the edit lands in the project where you rejected it — and flags it cross-project (advisory) — and a companion web UI on a deterministic per-project port for inline review and commenting.
